note: Read-only phone tasks: no login, nothing toggled, sent, paid or deleted. 'apps' lists the package names whose App Map is forgotten before a map-off run.

tasks.goal: Open Settings and tell me the Android version.
Open Settings and tell me the device name shown under About phone. Do not change anything.
Open Settings, open the Battery page and tell me the battery percentage. Do not change anything.
Open Settings, open the Storage page and tell me how much storage is used. Do not change anything.
Open Clock and list the alarms. Do not change any alarm.
Open Clock, go to the Timer tab and tell me the default timer value shown. Do not start it.
Open Clock, go to the Clock tab and list the cities shown. Do not add or remove any.
Open Calculator, work out 12 times 34 and tell me the result.
Open Calculator and open its history view. Tell me whether the history is empty. Do not clear it.
Open Chrome and open its three-dot menu. Tell me the first three menu entries, then close the menu. Do not open any page.
